title: Lesson 40: The Woods Are Alive
summary: Anna's New Year’s Resolution is to try something new. She auditions for a play. Will she get the part?

Director: Next! What is your name?
Anna: My name is Anna Matteo.
Director: Are you ready to audition?
Anna: (warms up voice) Yes.
Director: Great. Let's begin on page 1. Here is the story. You are lost in the woods. You are searching
Director: Now, say your line.
Anna: 'What was that? Hello. Is someone there?'
Director: Anna, you are speaking too
Anna: Yes, of course I can. 'What was that? Hello. Is someone there?' Is that loud
Director: Yes, that is loud enough. Let's turn to page 25. In this
Director: Anna. Anna! You are walking quickly and
Anna: I'm walking slowly and quietly. I am walking…
Director: Anna. Anna. You don't need to say "slowly" and "quietly." Alright, let's try the last scene. Turn to page 48. I say my
Director: 'You will never get out of these woods alive!
Anna: 'Yes, I will.'
Director: Okay, Anna, you said that line -- you said that line really
Anna: Sorry. Sorry. Let me try again.
Director: 'You will never …'
Director: '… get out of the woods alive.'

Anna: Director, how am I doing?
